title: I made a cozy game inspired by Animal Crossing, Stardew Valley, and RuneScape. It just got approved for iOS!
author: javiergame4
selftext:
Hey everyone!  
I’ve been working on my game Cozy Animals, and it just got approved for the App Store!

I’ve always loved Animal Crossing and Stardew Valley, but one thing I really enjoyed growing up was the skill grinding in RuneScape. I wanted to combine that sense of progression with a cute, relaxing world.

In Cozy Animals, you can fish, farm, mine, chop trees, cook, complete quests, decorate, and collect tons of outfits and cosmetics for your character. There are 10+ skills to level up, multiplayer to hang out with friends, and even fishing raids!

I wanted to make something where you can play casually for a few minutes or spend hours grinding toward your next unlock. There’s already a lot of content for people who love collecting things and leveling up.

The game is free on iOS with ads and I’m also working on a Steam release.

I’d love to hear what you guys think, especially from people who enjoy cozy games. What would you want to see added?

Used Claude Opus 5.5 with some Trello for some assets and used unity as engine. ChatGPT imagegen for some of the assets as well. 

iOS: https://apps.apple.com/app/cozy-animals/id6830466505

Thanks for checking it out! ❤️

comments.author: keytonw
comments.body: How long did approval take for you?

replies.author: javiergame4
replies.body: Took about 4 days, I’m still waiting for them to approve some other things for me too. Just need to make sure you have everything in order like website, video review, screenshots etc.

comments.author: LegendaryJohnny
comments.body: Ok I am now more calm - you prompted yourself to app store, so I guess my game will be approved too when its done in several years. Its because I just finished game mechanics, character creator and i am currently on fighting system. Quest, story, models, filling world with assets - yet to be done.

replies.author: javiergame4
replies.body: Hey it’s a process! Ai for sure speeds it up. I still got to polish more and more and add more updates to it and fix some bugs. I’d love to try your game out too!

comments.author: thevisitor_earth
comments.body:
It looks well put-together, creative work!

Not my cup of tea; I just prefer individual gameplay, scattered concepts from other games doesn't quite scratch the itch, when just playing a component game sounds better.

replies.author: javiergame4
replies.body: Thank you! I need to polish more and fix some bugs. What’s your fav type of games ?

replies.author: thevisitor_earth
replies.body:
I'd play Animal crossing but like, you've got critters running around with pickaxes. Why does everyone gotta use pickaxes?

  
You have infinite possibilities, pls no moar pickaxe is what I mean

replies.author: javiergame4
replies.body: Haha you can equip it/dequip items. Theres rocks you can mine with it, you need a pickaxe for it.  It’s RuneScape inspired if you ever played that.

replies.author: thevisitor_earth
replies.body:
Oh. Are there ores? Different rarities? How about gems? What about mines? Can we get enemies in the mines and maybe bombs?

Man you missed my point, I'm sorry.

replies.author: javiergame4
replies.body: Yes it has all that except enemies and bombs , no combat in this game.

comments.author: kiwiberrysaw
